game.name: Pizza Tower
game.rules:
## Overall Guidelines

- Any and all modifications to the game are disallowed. Only exception for this is changing ingame text through the ingame language feature.
- Runs should be performed on official releases and versions of the game. *Runs performed on mobile ports of the game are not allowed.*
- Game SFX and video from the game needs to be reasonably loud and clear with no editing or artifacts.
- *Full-game runs must have the ingame timer set to either "per save" or "both", NOT JUST "per level".*
- *The Speedrun Timer setting must also be turned on and show three decimals (If it doesn't, you may need to update your game).*
- The ingame timer and HUD must be enabled and clearly visible at all times. The game overall must also remain visible with no overlays/minimal overlay blocking it. If in doubt, apply opaque filters to your stream/recording assets you want to include.
- Full-game runs must show the file select screen at the start of the run *and Peppino's judgement and final results screen at the end.*
- You may use Steam Input to configure your controls. You may set any number of actions to any one button, *but you may not configure delays or any other timing elements into any of your binds*.

## Banned Stuff

- Setting up the Persistent Mort glitch before a full-game or IL run is not allowed.
- Performing the Double Revolver glitch (which requires multiple grab binds) is not allowed. *However, using taunts to perform double charge-shots **is** allowed.*
- You may not return to the main menu during a run in progress.
- Using the debug console during runs is strictly forbidden.

categories.rules:
## Any%

- Runs must show File Select at the beginning of the run and be done on a fresh save.
- Time starts on either playable character spawning in the Tower Entrance and ends upon going through the exit of The Crumbling Tower of Pizza.

categories.name: True Ending
categories.rules:
## True Ending

- Runs must show File Select at the beginning of the run and be done on a fresh save.
- Time starts on either playable character spawning in the Tower Entrance and ends upon going through the exit of The Crumbling Tower of Pizza.

- You must collect all treasures and unlock the true ending.

## 100%

- Runs must show File Select at the beginning of the run and be done on a fresh save.
- Time starts on either playable character spawning in the Tower Entrance and ends upon going through the exit of The Crumbling Tower of Pizza.

You must also do the following for every level and boss:

- Obtain an S rank or better. (Except on the Pizzaface and on Secrets of the World. You must still defeat Pizzaface.)
- Get every toppin, secret and treasure.

- You may not perform glitches that get Peppino out of bounds.
- You may not perform the Unfocused Extended Pause Abuse glitch.
- For Swap Mode: You may not perform the Dora glitch to do a Progression Transfer between levels (toppins, secrets, and treasure)

**Pause abuse is also completely disallowed.** More specifically, you also not perform any of the following Pause Abuse glitches:

- Phasing through enemies without interacting with them.
- Delaying john blocks from becoming solid after activating pizza time.
- Delaying room transitions.
- Extending button timers.
- Preserving enemies that should've died.
- Jumping off of water rapids.
- Dodging the pizza box transformation. (Specifically using pause abuse- dodging it through other means is fair game.)
- Preventing enemies and projectiles (and cheese balls) from spawning

values.name: Swap Mode (1P)
values.rules:
## Swap Mode (1P)

Runs must be performed by a single player, with one controller.

values.name: Swap Mode (2P)
values.rules:
## Swap Mode (2P)

**Runs must be performed by two players, using one controller each.**
